title: Zesty Bamboo Tray Australian Lamb Roast
description: A sophisticated centerpiece featuring slow-roasted Australian lamb shanks wrapped in paper-thin katsuramuki daikon sheets for a springy texture and bright citrus finish.

ingredients.name: Daikon radish
ingredients.notes: cut into 6-inch lengths for katsuramuki sheets

instructions: Preheat your oven to 160 degrees Celsius and line a large bamboo roasting tray with parchment paper.
Combine the olive oil, garlic, rosemary, lemon zest, salt, and pepper in a small bowl to create a rub.
Massage the herb rub thoroughly into each lamb shank until evenly coated.
Peel the daikon radish using the katsuramuki technique to create long, continuous thin sheets.
Wrap each seasoned lamb shank tightly in a daikon sheet and secure with kitchen twine if necessary.
Place the wrapped shanks onto the bamboo tray and cover the tray tightly with foil.
Roast the lamb in the oven for 150 minutes until the meat is tender and pulling away from the bone.
Remove the foil and brush the daikon exteriors with honey to encourage caramelization.
Increase the heat to 200 degrees Celsius and roast for another 15 minutes until the edges are golden.
Allow the roast to rest for 10 minutes before serving directly from the bamboo tray.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves and additional lemon zest before presenting to guests.
